entries.said: We are very confident that what we have talked about, that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year.
entries.quote: And we are very confident that what we have talked about, that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year.
entries.speaker: Kishor Patil
entries.delivered: Reported FY26 EBITDA margin was 19.0% (and company reported 20.8% on call 3), falling short of the 21% guidance.
entries.evidence: Annual table shows FY26 EBITDA margin at 19.0%; call 3 reported FY26 EBITDA margin at 20.8%.

entries.topic: Q3 FY26 flat/positive organic CC growth
entries.said: We believe that in the Quarter 3, we will be in a position to have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth.
entries.quote: We believe that in the Quarter 3, we will be in a position to have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth and while absorbing the expenses like increments, etc., we will be still around the similar EBITDA margins.
entries.speaker: Kishor Patil
entries.delivered: Reported Q3 FY26 Constant Currency Growth was 1.5%, achieving positive growth.
entries.evidence: Call 2 reported Q3 FY26 Constant Currency Growth: 1.5%; quarterly table shows revenue growth QoQ of 1.8%.

entries.said: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year.
entries.quote: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year. And we believe that we will be in a position to do it.
entries.speaker: Kishor Patil
entries.delivered: FY26 revenue growth was 10.5%. FY27 periods (Q1 FY27 YoY CC 0.1%, Q2 FY27 YoY revenue 6.5%) indicate lower growth.
entries.evidence: Annual table for FY26 growth (10.5%); Call 4 reported Q1 FY27 YoY CC revenue growth of 0.1%.

entries.topic: Q4 FY26 highest quarterly growth in FY26
entries.said: We believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
entries.quote: we believe that in the  last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
entries.speaker: Kishor Patil
entries.delivered: Q4 FY26 quarter-on-quarter revenue growth was 5.8%, higher than Q1 (+0.7%), Q2 (+3.2%), and Q3 (+1.8%).
entries.evidence: Quarterly table shows Q4 FY26 rev QoQ at 5.8%, exceeding Q1, Q2, and Q3.

entries.said: EBITDA margin is expected to be between 20.5% to 21.2% for FY27 post increasing investment in AI solutions.
entries.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.
entries.speaker: Kishor Patil
entries.delivered: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin reported was 17.2% (table 15.3%), Q2 FY27 reported was 17.8% (table 15.8%), currently running below guidance.
entries.evidence: Call 4 reported Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin: 17.2%; Call 5 reported EBITDA margin: 17.8%.

entries.said: H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4, driven by the Q4 performance
entries.quote: During the outlook, we have just mentioned that H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4, driven by the Q4 performance and our profitability will return  largely when the revenues come.
entries.speaker: Kishor Patil
entries.delivered: H2 FY27 period has not fully completed or reported in full set, though Q2 FY27 reported revenue of 1691.0 crore.
entries.evidence: Call 5 discusses H2 FY27 outlook; Q2 FY27 reported revenue growth QoQ was 1.0%.

summary: Management guidance has mixed reliability. While short-term quarterly targets like Q3/Q4 growth were met, full-year EBITDA margin targets for FY26 were missed, and current FY27 margins are running significantly below guided ranges.
business: KPIT Technologies provides engineering services and solutions to the automotive and mobility ecosystem. Segments include solutions and products, commercial vehicles, and off-highway domains.
bull: Q4 FY26 achieved the highest quarterly revenue growth of the year at 5.8% QoQ.
Q3 FY26 successfully delivered positive organic constant currency growth of 1.5%.
Commercial vehicle and off-highway segments showed robust growth of 27% YoY in Q2 FY27.
bear: FY26 EBITDA margin missed the 21% guidance, coming in lower at 19.0% (annual table).
Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 EBITDA margins dropped significantly to 15.3%-17.8%, missing FY27 guided ranges.
PAT declined severely in FY26 by 24.2% YoY, with ongoing double-digit YoY PAT drops through Q1 and Q2 FY27.
